about: One row for every asset in Mommy's World, written before the asset goes into the Unity project (no row, no ship). Fields: Unity Unicorn's asset ledger (findastra/unity-unicorn docs/asset-ledger-20261014.md) plus made, ai and designed_by (PROVENANCE.md). Proof such as receipts and permissions stays on the PC, never in Git.

made_values.handmade: Made by a person: Astra, or a club member who said yes.
made_values.ai-assisted: A person directed it and an AI did part of the work.
made_values.ai-generated: An AI made it and Astra approved it; only when Astra asks, each time.
made_values.third-party: Someone else's work, used under its licence and credited.
